title: Sekina Aoi's Asobi no Kankei Novels Get Manga Adaptation
content:
The 18th issue of Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine announced on Friday that Sekina Aoi 's Asobi no Kankei novels will get a manga adaptation by Koruri in the next issue on September 25. Kurehito Misaki is credited as the character designer.

The story follows dropout Kotarou Tokiwa, who is a substitute manager for the board game cafe Kurumaza. He falls in love with his coworker Mifuru Takanashi, a fashionable girl with no love for board games. Unfortunately for Kotarou, Mifuru has a boyfriend. He invents an imaginary girlfriend to hide his crush, who turns out to be a regular customer of the store.

Kadokawa 's Fujimi Fantasia Bunko imprint publishes the novels with illustrations by Misaki, and shipped the fourth novel on August 20.

Aoi and Ryō Tsuzura debuted the My Crush’s Crush ( Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito ) manga in Hakusensha 's Young Animal Zero magazine in November 2022. The seventh compiled book volume shipped in Japan on August 28. Yen Press licensed the manga. The series is inspiring an anime.

Aoi and Sabotenn launched the Gamers! novel series in 2014. Tsubasa Takahashi launched a manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Monthly Shōnen Ace magazine in October 2016. The series inspired a television anime adaptation that premiered in July 2017. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan. Funimation streamed an English dub and released the series on home video.

Aoi's previous Seitokai no Ichizon light novel series inspired The Student Council's Discretion television anime series in 2009, and the Student Council's Discretion Lv. 2 television anime series in 2012. Sentai Filmworks released the first anime on home video in March 2015, and released the second anime in May 2015.
author: ANN

title: Duel Masters Play's Smartphone Game Gets Duel Masters Pure Play's Manga
content:
A new manga titled Duel Masters Pure Play's , based on the Duel Masters Play's smartphone game, launched in Shogakukan 's Weekly CoroCoro Comic manga service on Monday. Reki Yayoi is drawing the manga. Hirokuni Nojima - the art director, character designer, and story writer for Duel Masters Play's - is credited for the manga's original story and supervision.

The manga is set in Duema City, a city where lovers of Duel Masters gather together. The manga centers on Kanon and Wedding, who are beings known as "Zeniths," who only have a vague understanding of human emotions and society. Through interacting with the various personalities and experiences of the city, they slowly come to an understanding of emotions.

The Duel Masters Play's smartphone game launched in December 2019.

Based on the long-running Duel Masters trading card game, Yō Kanebayashi and Shigenobu Matsumoto 's Duel Masters LOST Tsuioku no Suishō ( Duel Masters LOST: Crystal of Remembrance) manga launched in February 2024 and ended in March 2024. Kanebayashi and Matsumoto then launched the Duel Masters LOST ~Gekka no Shinigami~ ( Duel Masters LOST: Reaper of the Moon) manga in August 2024, and ended it in February 2025. Duel Masters LOST ~Bōkyaku no Taiyō~ , the third part of the manga, debuted in September 2025. Duel Masters LOST ~Danzai no Shōnen~ (The Sentencing Boy), the fourth part , debuted on March 26, and ended on July 2. The final chapter revealed the manga will have a fifth part titled "Shitsuraku no Duel," which will debut on September 17.

The net anime adaptation of Duel Masters LOST Tsuioku no Suishō debuted in October 2024 and had four episodes. The anime of Duel Masters LOST ~Gekka no Shinigami~ debuted in December 2024 and ended with its fourth and final episode in February 2025.The anime of Duel Masters LOST ~Bōkyaku no Taiyō~ debuted on February 6 with a four-episode streaming run. The anime's fourth part , Duel Masters LOST ~Danzai no Shōnen~ , will debut on October 9, and will stream four episodes.

title: Yuna Anisaki Launches Kōkyū Gohi no Kuroshiro na Oshigoto Manga on September 18
content:
Shogakukan 's Yawaraka Spirits manga website revealed last Friday that Yuna Anisaki will launch a new manga adapting Kazuki Karasawa 's Kōkyū Gohi no Kuroshiro na Oshigoto (The Black and White Duties of the Inner Palace's Lady of Go) novel. The manga will launch on September 18.

The fantasy story is set in the country of Ginran. It centers on Kairin, a girl whose strange black and white hair earns her scorn from all, This includes her parents, who mostly confine her to a room where she passes the time playing go by herself. One day, she runs away from home, and has a chance encounter with Seiken, who turns out to be Ginran's crown prince. When they play go together, Seiken looks up to Kairin as a master, and they swear never to be apart. But a palace conspiracy threatens Seiken's life, and they are forced to separate. Ten years later, Kairin sells herself to the services of the imperial rear palace, and there finds Seiken, now the emperor. Since their separation, Seiken has clung to the memory of Kairin. For the sake of her safety, Kairin hides her true identity, but another chance encounter allows Seiken a chance to see Kairin solve a problematic go puzzle.

Karasawa serialized the story in Kadokawa 's Kakuyomu website from April 23 to June 14 earlier this year. Kadokawa released the print volume of the story on June 15, with illustrations by Kasumi Nagi .

JManga previously released Momoshiro and Anisaki's My Sadistic Boyfriend ( S Kareshi Jyou-Jyou ) manga digitally in English, and Azuki ( now Omoi ) also began releasing it in 2023, distributed by Media Do International.

Cross Infinite World has published Karasawa's Too Strong to Belong! Banished to Another World! ( Saikyō Joshi, Isekai e Iku! ) and The Weakest Manga Villainess Wants Her Freedom! ( Maō-gun Shitennō no Saijaku Reijō wa Jiyū ni Ikitai! ) light novels in English.

title: BookWalker Expands Catalog with Mahjong Pros Publishing Titles
content:
Kadokawa 's BookWalker Global store announced on Tuesday that it is partnering with Mahjong set company Mahjong Pros ' Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint to expand its catalog with the publisher's titles.

The retailer added the following titles on the same day:

• Senba Kurono's 136 Ready-to-Use Mahjong Strategies and Tactics

• Hideki Ohwada's Reform with No Wasted Draws - The Legend of Koizumi (Volumes 1-2)

• Mio Junta and Suda Yoshiki's Crybaby Mermaid - Illustrated Memoir of Yuumi Uotani

• Ayato Sasakura's Vermilion Stella - Illustrated Memoir of Arisa Date (Volume 1)

BookWalker launched a new rebuilt website , apps, and reader in March, which includes the previously announced new Lightweight Content Protection (LCP) DRM system, which allows users to access purchases through LCP-compatible reading apps outside of BookWalker .

All English-language manga and light novels moved to the new BookWalker website and app, while Japanese content will remain on the existing website and app.

BookWalker Global changed in ownership from BookWalker Co., Ltd. to M12 Media LLC (formerly J-Novel Club LLC) in March 2025. BookWalker Co., Ltd. and J-Novel Club /M12 Media LLC are both Kadokawa Group companies.

The Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint focuses on licensing, localizing, and distributing mahjong-themed manga and textbooks. The company announced its Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint in June 2025.

title: Goodbye, Lara Anime Gets Manga
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kinema Citrus ' Goodbye, Lara ( Sayonara Lara ) original anime announced on Tuesday that the series will get a manga adaptation by Citrus creator Saburouta on Kadokawa 's KadoComi manga platform in October.

Crunchyroll is streaming the series as it airs and describes the story:

Once upon a time, a mermaid princess named Lara fell in love with a human prince. To be with him, she used a witch's potion to become human—but the magic came at a cost: If she failed to find true love, she would vanish into sea foam forever. Now, 200 years later, Lara awakens in Lake Biwa with one final chance at life and love.

The anime debuted on Sunday, July 5 at 24:30 (effectively July 6 at 12:30 a.m.) on Tokyo MX , before airing later that night on BS Asahi and YTV . The anime also airs on AT-X . Crunchyroll is also streaming an English dub .

Takushi Koide is directing the series at Kinema Citrus , and Anna Kawahara is overseeing the series scripts. Shiori Tani is the character designer, and Yuma Yamaguchi is composing the music at Kadokawa .

Ikimono-gakari performs the anime's opening theme song " Sayonara Lara ."

Goodbye, Lara tells a tale similar to Hans Christian Andersen 's The Little Mermaid . The story follows a mermaid who makes a forbidden wish to be loved by a human. Following her death, she is reborn 200 years later into modern-day Japan in Lake Biwa, where she learns to adjust in a human world. The setting of Lake Biwa is in Shiga prefecture of Japan, which is also where director Takushi Koide 's hometown is located.

title: Higurashi: When They Cry Mahjong Game Gets Remaster for Switch, PS5, PC
content:
City Connection announced on Tuesday that the 2009 Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong mahjong game for the Higurashi: When They Cry franchise is getting a remaster. The Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong Remaster game will launch for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam in Japan in 2027.

The original Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong game debuted for arcades in Japan in July 2009 before launching on PlayStation Portable that same year.

07th Expansion launched the first chapter of the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni visual novel software in 2002 at Comiket . The story revolves around murders that coincide with an annual festival in a quiet rural village. Ryukishi07 and 07th Expansion released Higurashi: When They Cry Hou for PC in Japan in 2014 as a "thank you" to series fans (the kanji used for Hō is used in the word Hōnō, "dedication").

The first Higurashi: When They Cry television anime series aired for 26 episodes in 2006, and the When They Cry II: Solutions ( Higurashi no Naku Koro Ni Kai ) anime aired for 24 episodes in 2007. Geneon Entertainment Inc. released the first anime on DVD in 2007-2008. Funimation then released the anime on DVD in 2009 and 2010. Sentai Filmworks released both anime on Blu-ray Disc and DVD in 2016.

The Higurashi: When They Cry – GOU television anime premiered in October 2020. Higurashi: When They Cry – SOTSU , the follow-up anime, premiered in July 2021.

A new television anime has been green-lit for the franchise . Studio DEEN is returning to animate the new anime. The anime will have a returning cast.

title: 24 Years Later, It’s Easier Than Ever to Watch Naruto
content:
There’s no denying that even several years after its ending, Masashi Kishimoto’s classic Weekly Shonen Jump series Naruto is still loved among global fans. This beloved manga began serialization in 1999, and not long after, Studio Pierrot’s anime adaptation in 2002 turned it into a global phenomenon. The main story was split into two parts in the anime, and Naruto: Shippuden premiered in 2007 to follow the protagonist after a two-and-a-half-year time skip. Even several years after the main story’s ending, fans are often looking forward to new releases and updates about the franchise.

While fans await more updates on the next anime project, Pluto TV confirmed streaming the episodes for free. It’s an ad-supported streaming television service that mimics traditional cable TV programming. The platform has been making anime series more accessible for fans, including all 220 episodes of the original Naruto anime free for fans. Pluto TV is officially available in the United States, Canada, the UK, Australia, Latin America, and select countries across Europe, so don’t forget to check your availability on the official website.

Naruto Is All Set to Return With a New Movie

Naruto has officially confirmed an anime movie , and updates will be revealed sooner than expected. Viz Media revealed last weekend that a Naruto panel will be taking place on October 10th during the New York Comic Con 2026 event. NYCC is one of the largest fan conventions dedicated to Western comics, series, graphic novels, video games, anime, manga, and more. The convention was first held in 2006, and since then, it has welcomed hundreds of thousands of visitors each year.

Apart from the movie, the panel will also share updates on the Naruto Card Game and more projects. However, it goes without saying that the biggest highlight of the panel will be the upcoming movie. Fans can expect the anime to drop its first look during this year’s NYCC. Since the main story is long over, it might be possible that Studio Pierrot is planning to release a completely original story even outside of everything that has happened in Boruto.

Will Naruto Still Release The Special Episodes?

It’s actually surprising that the anime movie got a first update before sharing new information on the four-episode mini series , which was announced as part of the 20th anniversary project. However, shortly before its premiere in September 2023, the anime was indefinitely delayed due to production issues.

With the latest confirmation of the new movie, it’s likely that the episodes were morphed into that format instead of being released as a series. However, there’s currently no information on what to expect from the special episodes, but the NYCC panel should clear up the confusion regarding the anime’s future.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Just Delayed a Major Release to 2027 – Watch New Trailer
content:
Jujutsu Kaisen has taken a major blow this year as it has just delayed a major new release until next year, but has released a new trailer to help show off more of it in the works. Jujutsu Kaisen has quite a lot to celebrate for the year thus far as the TV anime returned for its third season earlier this year to kick off the intense Culling Game arc from Gege Akutami’s original manga. Then it was quickly confirmed that a fourth season was now in the works for the next half of the arc .

But that wasn’t all that was revealed to be coming for the Jujutsu Kaisen franchise as it was also announced that Shueisha Games and studio poncle (the developers behind the massively popular Vampire Survivors games) were working on JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATION for an intended release in 2026 . But now the game has unfortunately revealed it’s now going to be releasing sometime next year following a major delay. You can check out the trailer for it below.

Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivation Release Delayed to 2027

JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATION was originally scheduled for a release on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2 and PC via Steam later this year, but a new delay has bumped to a new release sometime next year. No concrete release date has been revealed following this delay, but the new trailer for the title teases more of the characters that fans will be able to use. It also reveals the first look at many of the notable boss villains that players will be facing off against during their time with the game .

As for why JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATION has been delayed to next year, Shueisha Games shared an official statement on the matter on the title’s Steam page . Explaining that it was so the team has more time to develop the project and deliver as best of a final release as possible, the statement begins with, “We had been working toward a 2026 release, but in order to deliver the best possible experience to players, we have decided to move the release to 2027.”

What’s Next for Jujutsu Kaisen?

“The entire team is working hard to deliver the best survivors royale experience possible and live up to your expectations, so we hope you’ll bear with us a little longer!,” Shueisha Games statement ends. This delay might seem like a bummer for fans, but it’s not too bad of a delay considering it’s likely going to result in a much better project when it finally gets in the hands of players. There’s also plenty more to be excited about for the Jujutsu Kaisen franchise as Season 4 of the anime is also in the works for a release in the near future too.

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game has unfortunately yet to reveal a release window or date for its own return as of the time of this writing, but Takeru Sato will be directing the new episodes for studio MAPPA following his time with the third season. It’s going to be picking right back up with that cliffhanger seen in the third season when it hits, so make sure you’re all caught up with streaming services like Crunchyroll, Netflix and more.
